symptom: RunAsNode, NODE_OPTIONS and inspect fuses on: any process can run JS with Iris's mic, camera and Accessibility grants
cause: pnpm build left Electron fuses at their defaults
fix: electron-fuses write turns the three off, then codesign ad-hoc

symptom: a dropped .html in the chat or camera window would get the full window.iris bridge
cause: no will-navigate or setWindowOpenHandler on any window
fix: web-contents-created allows only the bundled src/gesture/*guide.html pages

symptom: no PermissionRequestHandler, every permission granted by default
cause: default session had no handler
fix: allow only media and clipboard-read for file: pages inside the app folder

symptom: style-src allowed unsafe-inline
cause: inline style blocks in chat.html and index.html
fix: styles moved to chat.css and hud.css, unsafe-inline removed

symptom: text from command hooks (SessionStart context, UserTurn/IrisTurn/ListenOnlyChanged context, Pre/PostToolCall context and block reasons, speak and Tick speak) reaches Gemini without tainting the session and without cleanOutput
cause: only plugin tool responses called taint.mark(); runGroup passed command output through str() only
fix: runGroup runs command text through cleanOutput and flags the group tainted; emit marks the session for side context and speak when sent, and returns tainted for SessionStart and Pre/PostToolCall so main marks it when that text is sent; a SessionStart command taints from the start and again after ↺; static hooks.json text does not taint

symptom: plugin tools ran in a tainted session; a confirm tool ran on confirmed:true sent by Gemini alone
cause: TAINT_GATED listed only the five desktop action tools
fix: while tainted, taint.check holds every plugin tool (id with __) with NEEDS_CONFIRMATION, confirmed:true included, until a real user turn clears the flag (user decision, plugin-pack-plan §6 item 5)
test: plugin-tools.selftest.mjs tainted session holds kit__send confirmed

symptom: a background child of a hook or tool survives a normal exit; command hooks still running at quit are not killed
cause: runCommand and runLate killed the process group only on timeout or settle; will-quit killed late processes only
fix: kill the group after close too; runCommand keeps live children in a set and killCommands() kills them at will-quit; setsid escape documented as a known limit
test: hooks.selftest.mjs background child killed after close, killCommands

symptom: a symlink to outside the plugin folder keeps the same hash while its target changes; command hooks use the trust cached at session start
cause: trustHash hashes link text only and loadPlugin checked containment for component JSON only; runGroup used the per-session isTrusted cache
fix: trustHash and loadPlugin (so also installFrom) refuse a symlink whose real path leaves the plugin folder or is broken; runGroup re-hashes with trustedNow before each command hook
test: hooks.selftest.mjs outside link refused, hook re-hash; plugin-tools.selftest.mjs install refuses outside link

symptom: PostToolCall context inside the [plugin tool result] text turn skips cleanOutput
cause: deliverLate copied post.context as is
fix: run post.context through cleanOutput in deliverLate

cause: the pending speak queue and runTool never re-read the switches; only active() does, at each event

symptom: asked what it can do, Iris could not say which tools are on or off, and tried tools that were switched off
cause: the prompt never named tools switched off in Settings, and there was no tool that lists abilities
fix: new list_my_abilities tool (numbered list of tools on and off, hand control, Gallery View); the prompt adds one 'Switched off in Settings now' line only when something is off; hooks.offTools lists off tools of plugins that are on and trusted; Settings switch 'Iris tự giới thiệu', default on
test: live-config.selftest.mjs prompt pointer, numbered output, off line; plugin-tools.selftest.mjs offTools hides untrusted plugins

feature: V1 latency log at the Start greeting
symptom: the greeting logged V1 voice_ms=874065, measured from the previous session's voice
cause: lastVoiceAt and lastHeardAt kept their values across Start
fix: reset lastVoiceAt and lastHeardAt at Start
test: none: main.mjs connect code has no test harness

symptom: camera flips off/on every 25-70 ms and the renderer logs Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'replaceChildren') 4 times at 10:22
cause: not a gesture bug: pnpm dev (electronmon) reloads the main window on every save under src/renderer/; each reload sends vision off (setup.js page load) then on (auto-start), which is the off/on burst. At 10:21:59-10:22:00 src/renderer/index.html was saved several times (mtime 17:22:00 local) while the in-progress plugin work already had plugins-ui.js render() calling $("plugin-tools").replaceChildren but index.html did not yet hold <div id="plugin-tools">; async load() threw on null. The later reloads in the same burst and all runs since (10:33, 10:37) have no such error. hud=off, so the HUD (hud-ui.js #cards) is ruled out
fix: no code fix in src/gesture: wontfix on user approval once a re-test on the current tree with no file saves running shows no error. Small aid: pipeLogs in hud.mjs logs sourceId:lineNumber for renderer errors so the next null target has a location
test: none for the transient; user hand test: toggle Hand Task Vision fast with no edits running

symptom: 246 [ERROR] [renderer] lines: odml.pa.googleapis.com blocked by CSP, 2 per app run
cause: @mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.2.3 sends usage telemetry with no opt-out; CSP default-src self blocks it on purpose, logger stops after the first failure
fix: log those lines at DEBUG instead of ERROR; CSP unchanged
